ruleDefinitions.name: New Root Certificate Installed Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of "certutil" with the "addstore" flag in order to install a new certificate on the system.
Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-addstore.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/addstore.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*root.*"))
